newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian 91-day T-bill rate dips to 8.27 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian 91-day T-bill rate dips to 8.27 pct.

text.p: The average yield on Lithuanian 91-day Treasury bills fell at an auction on Tuesday to 8.27 percent from 9.23 percent last week, the central bank said.
All amounts are in millions of litas.
MATURITY AVG YIELD (LAST TIME) MIN/MAX ISSUE BID SOLD
The settlement date for the bills is January 31, and the bills mature on May 2.
The next auction will be on February 3 when 50 million litas of 91-day paper will be sold and on February 4 when 40 million litas of 182-day paper will be auctioned.
